authority: Line owner 2026-10-22: Twelve Gazes E01 viewer review (forced camera motion, mechanical direction alternation, scripted cuts rendered as drifts). Quality from better direction, not more gates.
activation_note: Never retroactive. Active only when the generation contract declares camera_grammar_policy=CAMERA_GRAMMAR_V1 (storyclaw finalize stamps newly sealed contracts) or the episode is listed here. LEGACY_FORCED_MOTION opts out.
effects: static_design_gate: forced-motion rules R1-R4/R6/R7 are REPORT_ONLY advisories; English dialogue timed in words (R8)
camera plans stamped camera_grammar: grouped adjacent-direction and five-unit direction caps dropped (identical family+direction check kept)
build_keyframe_manifest: an authored cut or scene change opens on its own keyframe instead of the previous tail

dialogue: speaking shots show only the speaker (single or over-the-shoulder, speaker centred); two-shots only when nobody speaks; sound bridges carry a line onto the listener's reaction; cut tighter only at an emotional turn

S7 L-cut: a silent reaction shot's prompt_spec.transition.sound_bridge_from_previous_seconds (0.3-2.0) cuts the speaker picture early and plays the line (and subtitle) over the reaction (tools/dialogue_sound_bridge.py)

keyframes (2026-10-24): fixed-element requirement by shot size - CLOSE_UP/EXTREME_CLOSE_UP/MEDIUM_CLOSE_UP none (at most one or two soft behind, the person fills the frame, explicit picture range), MEDIUM at most 2, wider unchanged; keyframe Q1 space_anchors_match judges by the same rule (expectations.fixed_element_rule)

dialogue (2026-10-24): during a spoken line the speaker's eyes stay on the listener; never a turn to a window/door/off-screen object or 'eyes fixed on X' inside a speaking shot (a look gets its own silent shot or an insert); the H3 renderer adds 'While speaking <name> keeps her/his eyes on the listener; the camera does not follow her/his gaze.'

S6 tail start frames (2026-10-24): a continuous unit with an on-screen speaker takes the previous unit's tail only if the objective speaker check (video_q2_builder start-frame-check) accepts it; otherwise start_frame_source OWN_KEYFRAME_TAIL_REJECTED and its own keyframe comes from the S5 path (~11 credits)

controlled redo (2026-10-24): a unit parked after an objective Q2 speaker-framing / face-count FAIL gets a new own keyframe instead of re-shooting from the same start frame (nalu_pipeline.redo_switch_start_frames)
